description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the rates of exchange effective from 04.06.2018 - 10.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of new currency exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation of statutory powers (Section 17 of the Customs Ordinance) and establishes official rates for financial calculations, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
